name: Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection
native_kbm_note: PS5 version has no keyboard/mouse gameplay support; KBM controls exist only in the PC port (Iron Galaxy). No source lists KBM on PS5.
notes: Single source (StrategyWiki Uncharted 4 controls table with PS4 and PC columns; Uncharted 4 on PC only exists as Legacy of Thieves, and The Lost Legacy shares the scheme). PS5 layout equals PS4. SPACE = jump and shoulder swap while aiming, both CROSS on PS. LSHIFT = roll/evade/take cover and drop while climbing, both CIRCLE. LCTRL = piton (SQUARE); on PC LCTRL is also slow walk (no PS button). E = interact and R = reload both send TRIANGLE (PS uses Triangle for both). TAB = target last attacker and V = locate ally, both D-pad down on PS. Mouse wheel swaps weapons on PC; mapped to D-pad left/right like keys 1/2. Sprint is not listed in the source and is omitted. Driving: W/S go to the left stick with this tool, so use MOUSE1 (R2) to accelerate and MOUSE2 (L2) to reverse; handbrake (SQUARE, PC LSHIFT) and horn (TOUCHPAD, PC right click) are not reproduced.
